title: The Sky Firefly Item Pack
description: This mod adds 7 complete enchantments and 3 incomplete items due to it being a custom content pack added for the scripted Minecraft series Sky Firefly.
body:
This is a mod specially made for Sky Firefly, a scripted Minecraft server, as an added content pack that is used in every episode, mainly used for the plot. This adds:
- 7 enchantments relevant to each of the teams.
- The unfinished versions of three items that might spoil some later parts of the series.

We suggest you download it as it helps you explore more of the series, it gives you new enchantments to use in survival minecraft (kinda op if you like op), and (if you like them,) spoilers that come in the form of new items and swords that is after netherite. It is also occaisonally updated for the latest version, and is also a host of the newer content to the server that you can find in each episode.
